svg.text: The loops of K1 as strips, to the same scale as each other and as the great circle (the bar at the top). A loop has no seam either: it wraps exactly as the great circle does.
Best loop of 76800: 2 cities, 4 towns, 4 biomes, 71% land (55% settled)
Best loop of 38400: 1 city, 3 towns, 3 biomes, 71% land (66% settled)
Round a pole, 38,400 units each (the loop is 14.5 degrees from the pole)
North: sea ice and open water (64% ice)
Each strip is the whole loop with the touch-down in the middle. The boxes under it are the places the line passes, as in picture B.
